notes: VERIFIED IDENTITY: bloomr.com IS the UAE business. Shopify store 'bloomr-dubai.myshopify.com', Shopify.country='AE', currency AED, Shopify.locale='en'; page title 'Bloomr UAE: Shop Furniture, Artificial Flowers, Trees & Home Decor'. English is the default storefront (Arabic and Russian exist only as /ar and /ru sub-locales), so canonical English URLs were used. Reached by DIRECT FETCH; no proxy needed. SCOPE: Bloomr is faux-botanical-led, but it is NOT faux-only - it carries three large, genuinely separate in-scope ranges with their own mega-menu sections and product listings: Home Decor (3,776), Lighting (1,167) and Tableware (267). Every artificial flower / tree / plant / stem / spray / bouquet / wreath collection (roughly 100 collections) was EXCLUDED per this batch's faux-botanical rule. COUNT METHOD: qty is the storefront's own rendered listing header, div id='ProductCount' span.facets__label, e.g. '1-48 of 580 products'. Per Rule 1 the Shopify structured count was NOT used. Counts were proven exact three ways: (a) the header's own pagination progress bar equals 48/total; (b) last-page boundary - /collections/vases?page=13 renders '577-580 of 580 products' and page=14 renders zero tiles, /collections/decorative-trays?page=2 renders '49-68 of 68 products' and page=3 renders zero; (c) full enumeration of unique product handles returned exactly 314 for Tree & Plant Pots and exactly 86 for Plant Pots, matching their headers. PLANTERS: Tree & Plant Pots and Plant Pots were included only after verifying they are NOT vessels bundled with faux arrangements - they are standalone purchasable SKUs (e.g. 'White Terrazzo Pot - Small/Medium/Large', 'Round Ceramic Pot') with their own PDPs, prices and add-to-cart, described as 'a stylish standalone accessory'. They sit under the site's Trees and Plants menus but are their own listings; the two collections were checked for overlap and share ZERO products. CANDLES: included only after confirming they are unscented decorative taper and pillar candles (no scent/fragrance/aroma wording on the PDPs); Bloomr has no home-fragrance range. EXCLUSIONS INSIDE OTHERWISE IN-SCOPE MENUS: 'Decorative Boxes & Jewelry Boxes' (145) dropped - all 144 sampled titles across 3 pages are jewelry boxes and the PDP copy sells them as 'practical storage' to 'keep your treasured pieces organized', so the category is storage-led; 'Baskets & Rattan' (14) dropped - water-hyacinth storage baskets sold to 'keep your space clutter-free... neatly out of sight'; Cushion Covers (1,012), Throws (51), Placemats and Napkins & Napkin Holders dropped as textiles; Cutlery (25) dropped as flatware; Bulbs (9) dropped as lighting hardware; Bathroom Accessories (8) dropped. Also excluded wholesale: all Furniture, Bedlinen & Towels, Rugs & Carpets, Christmas/ornaments, and Sale/Outlet/Best-Seller promo collections. HIERARCHY NOTE: Mirrors and Paintings and Wall Art are the site's own children of the Home Decor mega-menu and are kept in that group. Sibling collections cross-list (e.g. some vases also appear in Glass Decor), which is normal Shopify behaviour; each row is the site's own separate listing and its own header total.
